title: Testing Vue Apps
objectives: Test stores with fresh Pinia instances
Component-test user flows with Vue Test Utils
Mock at the service seam, not internals
body:
# Testing Vue Applications

## The pyramid for this codebase

1. **Utils/composables** — pure, no mount (`useMarkdown` sanitizer).
2. **Stores** — behavior without DOM; mock only the IPC service module.
3. **Components** — mount real component + real stores, fake services.
4. E2E (Tauri WebDriver) — reserved for launch/persistence smoke tests.

## Store test skeleton (used in this repo)

```ts
vi.mock('@/services/ipc', () => ({ ipc: { completeLesson: vi.fn(...) } }))
beforeEach(() => setActivePinia(createPinia()))   // isolation per test

it('completing unlocks dependents', async () => {
  const store = useProgressStore()
  store.applySummary(freshSummary)
  await store.complete('rust', 'rust-01', 'l1')
  expect(store.isModuleLocked('tauri-01')).toBe(false)
})
```

Fresh `createPinia()` per test prevents cross-test state bleed — the #1 flaky
store-test cause.

## Component tests assert behavior

```ts
const wrapper = mount(QuizPanel, { props: {...}, global: { plugins: [pinia] } })
await wrapper.findAll('input[type=radio]')[3].setValue()
await wrapper.find('[data-testid="quiz-submit"]').trigger('click')
expect(wrapper.find('[data-testid="quiz-result"]').text()).toContain('Passed')
```

Query by role/testid, not classes. Assert outcomes users observe.

## Mock at boundaries you own

`@/services/ipc` is the single Tauri seam — mocking it means zero Tauri in
jsdom. Avoid mocking store internals or Vue itself; those are your system
under test.
